html:
Quest Giver: Gee Dubya Shrub

Quest Type: Talk to

Quest Description: Go talk about Sitar Hero to Tipper Gourd.

Quest Reward: 7500 Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Tipper Gourd

Repeatable: No


After completing the above quest, another quest with the same name is given:

Quest Giver: Tipper Gourd

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill MC_Whammy_Bar (who has been beating Tipper Gourd's score in Sitar Hero) in Mutanous Malaise, Level 3.

Quest Reward: 7500 Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Tipper Gourd

Repeatable: No


After completing the above quests, another quest with the same name is given:

Quest Giver: Tipper Gourd

Quest Type: Talk to

Quest Description: Go talk about Sitar Hero to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Quest Reward: 7500 Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Loremaster Vraile

After completing the above quests, another quest with the same name is given:

Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Description: Kill M3R0CK in Mutanous Malaise, Level 5.

Quest Reward: 7500 Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Loremaster Vraile

After completing the above quests, another quest with the same name is given:

Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Talk to

Quest Description: Go talk about Sitar Hero to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Quest Reward: 7500 Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No


After completing the above quests, another quest with the same name is given:

Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill Princess_Slayer57, who has been cheating in Sitar Hero, in Mutanous Malaise, Level 7.

Quest Reward: 7500 Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill Princess_Slayer57 in Mutanous Malaise, Level 7, and return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Offer:

It's like everyone thinks that I'm all business, but it just isn't true. I love playing games! When I heard about this Sitar Hero craze, I had to check it out, so I snuck into Mutanous Malaise and played a couple games while no one was looking. Well, every night since I've been sneaking into that dungeon so I can try to set the High Scores, and every morning some creature in the dungeon has already beaten them.

I found out the name of this creature, Princess_Slayer57, and I want you to get in there and do your job. I'm not just asking you to do this because I can't beat him on my own. I have proof that the creatures which have been beating High Scores set by all the great Sitar Hero players have been doing so with the help of a hacked skill called SitarBot. Now, I hate creatures, but I hate cheating creatures even more.

Find Princess_Slayer57 in Mutanous Malaise, Level 7, and punish him for cheating. When you've taught that creature a lesson you should return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

Everyone is rejoicing! We can now set High Scores without having to worry that some creature in the dungeon will use a hack to beat it. Now, maybe you can get a chance to try out Sitar Hero if you haven't already. Good work, Dungeon Runner, you have done the Kingdom proud!

Objectives:

  • Princess_Slayer57

Level range: 30–50
